name: Ilha de Itamaracá (Brazil)
description: White field with a light blue triangle based on the fly edge, charged towards the hoist with a white disc in a yellow ring bearing the municipal arms with grapes and a crown, between the dates 06-10-1534 and 01-01-1954.
history: Ilha de Itamaracá is a municipality in the state of Pernambuco, Brazil.
